facts.fact: Google announced on 2026-11-04 that Fab AI, funded by Google.org and the Gates Foundation, will lead local innovators in Kenya, Ghana and South Africa to build bespoke AI tools for teachers on open Gemma models, aiming at up to 500 teachers and 15,000 students in a first phase.
facts.system: Google DeepMind-Fab AI open Gemma teacher tools
